libraries.name: Lenis
libraries.detectedVia: window.lenisVersion === "1.0.29" read at runtime; same literal window.lenisVersion="1.0.29" in app.js
libraries.role: OWNS SCROLLING. Native-scroll mode, not transform mode: window.scrollY advanced to 15352 while the content wrapper computed transform was 'none'. <html> carries lenis lenis-smooth lenis-scrolling. Configured wheelMultiplier: 1.6. Nested scrollers opt out with data-lenis-prevent (4 modals).

libraries.name: locomotive-scroll
libraries.detectedVia: v5 constructor signature in app.js ({scrollCallback, modularInstance, lenisOptions, triggerRootMargin, rafRootMargin, autoResize, initCustomTicker, destroyCustomTicker}) exposing .lenisInstance and .coreInstance; v5-only DOM attribute data-scroll-module-progress. No version constant survives the build.
libraries.role: OWNS REVEALS AND SCROLL PROGRESS. Layered deliberately ON TOP OF Lenis, not in conflict: v5 deleted its own smooth-scroll engine and delegates easing to Lenis via lenisOptions, keeping only the IntersectionObserver in-view/progress layer. 37 elements carry data-scroll. Attributes seen live: data-scroll, -call, -call-self, -repeat, -offset, -speed, -event-progress, -module-progress, -orientation, -disable-touch-speed, -to, -to-offset.

libraries.role: OWNS TWEENING. Scroll-linked tweens and callbacks; 30 inline transform styles observed mid-page.

libraries.name: modularjs
libraries.detectedVia: this.namespace = "modular" in a constructor whose defaults are {transitionDelay, isLoaded, isEntered, isUrl, transitionContainer, popstateIgnore}; <body data-module-load>; 41 elements with data-module-* attributes
libraries.role: OWNS PAGE TRANSITIONS and module binding. Locomotive's own loader (modularorg/modularjs, successor to modujs). Receives scroll progress from locomotive-scroll via modularInstance. THIS IS WHAT REPLACES BARBA.

libraries.name: three.js
libraries.detectedVia: var C0="152" immediately followed by three's MOUSE/TOUCH constant tables ({LEFT:0,MIDDLE:1,RIGHT:2,ROTATE:0,DOLLY:1,PAN:2}) - how REVISION survives minification
libraries.role: TWO separate WebGL scenes. (1) window.gradient - full-viewport ShaderMaterial plane through an EffectComposer customPass, canvas in .c-gradient, persists across page transitions, reacts to theme change. (2) .c-section-3d_scene - Draco-decoded product GLB with a 6-face cubemap. 18 ShaderMaterial, 57 'varying vec2', 36 gl_FragColor - hand-written GLSL.
